title: shopify-app-kit manifest (schema v1)
description: Per-repo facts a Shopify app repo declares in .claude/shopify-app.json so the kit's guard hooks, doctor and skills can act on them. The top level is closed; sections may grow additively.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint: a URL to this schema (for example the raw file at a kit tag). Ignored by the hooks.

$comment.description: Optional free-text note for humans reading the manifest. Ignored by the hooks.

version.description: The kit version whose hooks were last vendored into this repo by /shopify-app-kit:sync; null before the first sync.

portfolioId.description: An opaque id for this product in the kit's portfolio, never a business, product or store name: cross-repo routines discover consumers by this key and refer to them by it only.

routines.description: The kit routines this product runs, by file name under the kit's routines/ without .md; the maintainer creates one trigger per entry.

configs.description: Shopify CLI config names (the X in shopify.app.X.toml) the guard requires on app dev / app deploy.

packageManagers.description: Repo-relative directory ("." for the root) to the package manager used there.

auth.description: How the app authenticates with Shopify beyond the defaults of the app library.

expiringOfflineTokens.description: True when the app runs future.expiringOfflineAccessTokens in its Shopify server module and its session table carries refreshToken and refreshTokenExpires. Shopify requires expiring offline access tokens for public apps created on or after 2026-04-01 and for all public apps from 2027-01-01 (60-minute access token, 90-day refresh token; obtaining a new token invalidates the previous refresh token, so one live refreshable token per app per store).

method.description: How merchants are charged. app-pricing: Shopify App Pricing (the successor of Managed Pricing), the default for public apps and available to public apps only; subscription webhooks are not delivered and status comes from the Partner Active Subscription API. billing-api: the Billing API, labelled legacy but functional and the only path for custom-distribution apps. none: the app does not charge.

docs.description: Where the repo keeps its decision records and its docs map, so the docs-owner skill and the docs-consistency test know where to look.

adrDir.description: Repo-relative directory of the architecture decision records, one file per decision (for example docs/adr).

mapFile.description: Repo-relative file that carries the docs map, the table naming one owning document per fact family (for example README.md).

mapHeading.description: The markdown heading under which mapFile carries the docs map (for example "## Docs map").

classify.description: How the app calls a cheap, high-speed classification provider (Jev / TypeSafe) for typed, calibrated decisions. Every classify call names a labelSet declared here; the transport is billed and budgeted, and a call auto-acts only at or above its confidence threshold. Additive: absent means the app ships no classification.

provider.description: The classification provider. `jev` is TypeSafe's System One model, called through @typesafe-ai/sdk with TYPESAFE_API_KEY; it returns a typed Choice (one label from a fixed set), Score or boolean with a calibrated confidence, never a free-text string.

defaultEscalateThreshold.description: The confidence (0..1) below which any classify call escalates to a human or a fallback instead of auto-acting, unless its labelSet overrides it. A calibrated classifier abstains rather than guessing under this floor.

budget.description: The per-tenant spend ceiling for billed classify calls; the transport decrements it in the same transaction it records the call and refuses when exhausted, the rule mcp-connector applies to every billed tool.

monthlyCap.description: Maximum classify spend per tenant per calendar month, in the provider's billing unit.

labelSets.description: The registry of candidate label sets, one per classification job, keyed by an id the calling code references. This is the single source of truth a tripwire asserts the code's Choice options against; a call naming an id absent here is rejected.

labels.description: The candidate labels for this job, up to 255 (Jev's Choice cap); the classifier returns exactly one, never a label outside this set.

escalateThreshold.description: The confidence (0..1) below which a call on this labelSet escalates instead of auto-acting; overrides defaultEscalateThreshold.
